newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Two Swedish officials booked aboard Ethiopia plane.
newsitem.headline: Two Swedish officials booked aboard Ethiopia plane.

text.p: Two Swedish foreign ministry staff were booked on the hijacked Ethiopian Airlines plane that crashed on Saturday and have not yet been accounted for, a ministry spokesman said on Saturday.
Staffan Bjorck said the two Swedes, one each from the embassies in Kenya and Ethiopia, were booked on the plane that was hijacked and later crashed near the Comoro Islands.

"All we know is that two foreign ministry staff, one from our embassy in Addis and the other in Nairobi, were booked on to the flight and were taken out to the plane. We have heard nothing about them since," Bjorck told Reuters.
The Swedish news agency TT added that it was believed the two were intending to go on holiday to Zanzibar.
Bjorck said the ministry would not release the names of the two staff at this stage.
